{{RaceIcon|Grell}} [[Grell]] |boss= {{RaceIcon|Theradras}} [[Princess Theradras]] |type=Dungeon |level=45-55 |players=5 |bosses={{Maraudon}} }} '''Maraudon''' is a 5-player dungeon consisting of a system of caves located in the [[Valley of Spears]] in [[Desolace]], north east of [[Shadowprey Village]]. It is a combination of ancient [[centaur]] burial grounds, as well as a primal temple dedicated to the elemental earth. ==History== From the [https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Game_Guide/World_Dungeons World Dungeons] page on the official World of Warcraft Community Site: :''Protected by the fierce Maraudine centaur, Maraudon is one of the most sacred sites within Desolace. The great temple/cavern is the burial place of Zaetar, one of two immortal sons born to the demigod, Cenarius. Legend holds that Zaetar and the earth elemental princess, Theradras, sired the misbegotten centaur race. It is said that upon their emergence, the barbaric centaur turned on their father and killed him. Some believe that Theradras, in her grief, trapped Zaetar's spirit within the winding cavern - used its energies for some malign purpose. The subterranean tunnels are populated by the vicious, long-dead ghosts of the Centaur Khans, as well as Theradras' own raging, elemental minions.'' ==Geography== ===Maps and subregions=== File:WorldMap-MaraudonEntrance.jpg|Exterior File:WorldMap-Maraudon.jpg|Interior {| class="fandom-table" |- |[[Earth Song Falls]] • [[Foulspore Cavern]] • [[Noxious Hollow|The Noxious Hollow]] • [[Poison Falls]] • [[Vyletongue Seat]] • [[Wicked Grotto|The Wicked Grotto]] • [[Zaetar's Grave]] |} {{clrl}} == Dungeon denizens == * {{RaceIcon|Basilisk}} [[Basilisk]]s * {{RaceIcon|BogBeast}} [[Bog beast]]s * {{RaceIcon|Centaur|Male}}{{RaceIcon|Centaur|Female}} [[Centaur]]s * {{RaceIcon|Crocolisk}} [[Crocolisk]]s (one, [[Rotgrip]]) * {{RaceIcon|Diemetradon}} [[Diemetradon]]s * {{RaceIcon|Cenarian|Female}} [[Dryad]]s * {{RaceIcon|Earth}} [[Earth elemental]]s * {{RaceIcon|Ghost}} [[Ghost]]s * {{RaceIcon|Goblin|Male}} [[Goblin]]s (one, [[Tinkerer Gizlock]]) * {{RaceIcon|Grell}} [[Grell]]s * {{RaceIcon|Hydra}} [[Hydra]]s * {{RaceIcon|Lasher}} [[Lasher]]s * {{RaceIcon|Larva}} [[Larva]]e * {{RaceIcon|Cenarian|Male}} [[Keeper of the grove|Keeper]]s * {{RaceIcon|MountainGiant}} [[Mountain giant]]s * {{RaceIcon|Ooze}} [[Ooze]]s * {{RaceIcon|Satyr|Male}}{{RaceIcon|Satyr|Female}} [[Satyr]] * {{RaceIcon|Treant}} [[Treant]]s * {{RaceIcon|Turtle}} [[Turtle]]s * {{RaceIcon|PlagueWater}} [[Water elemental]]s (one, [[Noxxion]]) * {{RaceIcon|Worm}} [[Worm]]s == Quest guide == {| class="fandom-table" |- !Quest name !Quest giver !Zone location |- !
